responsibility: This header defines the FreeBSD-specific AArch64 subtarget configuration, layering OS ABI and driver behavior on top of the generic AArch64 ELF port. It sets FreeBSD preprocessor and linker specs, chooses the proper linker emulation for endianness, adjusts start/end file handling and math runtime objects, installs exec-stack and symbol-binding hooks, overrides wchar_t to the AAPCS form, and integrates the generic AArch64 erratum linker options into FreeBSD builds.
